info.plot: Destinato a un matrimonio combinato, un giovane principe africano vuole invece scegliersi una moglie di suo gusto e decide di cercarla a New York, trovandola nella figlia del proprietario di una catena di "fast food".

translations.overview: An African prince decides it’s time for him to find a princess... and his mission leads him and his most loyal friend to Queens, New York. In disguise as an impoverished immigrant, the pampered prince quickly finds himself a new job, new friends, new digs, new enemies and lots of trouble.
translations.tagline: This summer, Prince Akeem discovers America.
